purpose: Decide the NNUE V2 label source: the v1 shape trained on NNUE v1 depth-10 labels (arm N) against the same shape trained on v1's HCE 2000 ms labels (arm H), everything else identical.
hypothesis: Arm N plays stronger than arm H at 2s+0.02s, one thread, without tablebases.

N.label: NNUE v1 (DLL 32c32302, model 07b9ab0f) depth 10, part2_d10_all.jsonl sha256 3002980652d0c824ad6f3e864cfa7f9dc5874daa12926fab19d5b6fa9d5f9269

shared.dll_source: this branch; the default build of the same source is the strict control 8b82fef8

command: python -B -m makhos sprt --dev-library build/pilot/armN/makhos_native_nnue_candidate_v1.dll --master-library build/pilot/armH/makhos_native_nnue_candidate_v1.dll --dev-nnue-model build/pilot/armN/armN_seed20261015.mknnue --master-nnue-model build/pilot/armH/armH_seed20261015.mknnue --threads 1 --persistent-search --search-hash-power 20 --no-tablebase --time 2 --inc 0.02 --opening-plies 6 --seed 20261017 --parallel-games 2 --max-game-plies 300 --elo0 0 --elo1 5 --pairs 2000 --output build/pilot/sprt-part2-20261009/sprt.json --resume
run_tree: build/runs/nnue2_pilot_p2 (git archive of this commit plus the two DLLs and models)

decision.PASS: NNUE fixed-depth labels are the V2 label source.
decision.FAIL: Keep HCE-quality labels; try deeper or mixed labels before scaling.
decision.cap: INCONCLUSIVE; report Elo and interval; prefer the cheaper source only with owner agreement.

restrictions: No rerun with a new seed to chase a PASS.
Development models only; nothing here is promoted.
